h1_old: How to Dismiss a Traffic Ticket in Fort Worth with Defensive Driving

faqs.q: How much does it cost to dismiss a ticket in Fort Worth?
faqs.a: The court cost is typically up to about $144 ($169 in a school zone) and is set by each court — some Tarrant-area courts charge less. The TDLR-approved course is separate; ours is $28. Check your court's page for the exact amount.

faqs.q: Can I take the course online for a Tarrant County ticket?
faqs.a: Yes. Once the court approves your request, a TDLR-approved 6-hour course can be completed fully online. Every Fort Worth-area court accepts a state-approved online course.

faqs.q: My ticket is from Arlington / North Richland Hills, not Fort Worth. Does that change things?
faqs.a: The process is the same, but you deal with that city's court, which sets its own fee, request method, and deadlines. Open its page in the table above.

faqs.q: How long do I have to finish?
faqs.a: Generally 90 days after the court approves the request. Request the course by your appearance date first, and don't pay the ticket — paying is a guilty plea and a conviction.

faqs.q: Does a dismissal keep it off my insurance?
faqs.a: Yes. A driving safety course dismissal keeps the charge off your driving record under Texas law, so it can't raise your insurance — unlike paying, which is a conviction.

courts.name: Fort Worth Municipal Court
courts.note: Fort Worth takes DSC requests within 21 calendar days of the citation date (judicial approval is required after that) — and says not to send money with the request; the court bills you after approval.

courts.name: Arlington Municipal Court
courts.note: You'll need a certified Type 3A driving record from Texas DPS — most drivers do not have this ready.

courts.name: Bedford Municipal Court
courts.note: You'll need a certified Type 3A driving record from Texas DPS — most drivers do not have this ready.

courts.name: Benbrook Municipal Court
courts.note: Benbrook (SW Fort Worth, I-20/US-377) takes the DSC request in person within 10 days of your offense — don't pay online if you want dismissal; 90 days.

courts.name: Blue Mound Municipal Court
courts.note: Blue Mound (north Fort Worth, US-287) takes the DSC request in person at the court window by your appearance date; 90 days, TDLR-approved course + DPS record.

courts.name: Colleyville Municipal Court
courts.note: Colleyville charges $144 ($169 school zone, incl. $10 admin fee) — request with the clerk by your court date; insurance proof must be a paper copy.

courts.name: Crowley Municipal Court
courts.note: Crowley gives you only 11 days from the citation to request DSC — by email, mail, or in person.

courts.name: Dalworthington Gardens Municipal Court
courts.note: Dalworthington Gardens (enclave in Arlington) approves the DSC at the court's discretion — request in person or by phone by your appearance date; don't pay online first.

courts.name: Edgecliff Village Municipal Court
courts.note: Edgecliff Village (south Fort Worth, US-287) approves the DSC before you pay — call or email by your appearance date; don't pay online or you'll be convicted.

courts.name: Euless Municipal Court
courts.note: You'll need a certified Type 3A driving record from Texas DPS — most drivers do not have this ready.

courts.name: Everman Municipal Court
courts.note: Everman (SE Fort Worth, US-287) takes the DSC request in person by your appearance date — court costs plus an admin fee due then; 90 days.

courts.name: Forest Hill Municipal Court
courts.note: Forest Hill takes DSC requests by email or fax and charges $144 ($169 school zone).

courts.name: Grapevine Municipal Court
courts.note: You'll need a certified Type 3A driving record from Texas DPS to submit with your certificate. Court fee: $144.

courts.name: Haltom City Municipal Court
courts.note: You'll need a certified Type 3A driving record from Texas DPS — most drivers do not have this ready.

courts.name: Haslet Municipal Court
courts.note: Haslet (north Tarrant, I-35W) charges $144 ($169 school zone) — request in person, by mail, or phone; DSC payments can't go through the online portal.

courts.name: Hurst Municipal Court
courts.note: Hurst's court fee is $144 for most violations. Take a $28 TDLR-approved defensive driving course online. Certificate downloads the same day.

courts.name: Keller Municipal Court
courts.note: Keller tickets go through the joint Keller-Colleyville court in Colleyville — $144 plus a $10 admin fee.

courts.name: Kennedale Municipal Court
courts.note: Kennedale takes a DSC request online, in person, or by mail before your due date — don't pay online first or it's a conviction.

courts.name: Lake Worth Municipal Court
courts.note: Lake Worth (SH-199) takes DSC requests through its online form and gives 90 days — you lose the option if you miss your appearance date.

courts.name: Lakeside Municipal Court
courts.note: Lakeside (NW Tarrant, near Lake Worth) charges $144 — submit a notarized request by email, in person, or mail by your appearance date; 90 days, Type 3A record.

courts.name: Mansfield Municipal Court
courts.note: Mansfield requires a signed DSC affidavit before you enroll — most drivers miss this step. Court fee: $144.

courts.name: North Richland Hills Municipal Court
courts.note: You'll need a certified Type 3A driving record from Texas DPS — most drivers do not have this ready.

courts.name: Pantego Municipal Court
courts.note: Pantego (enclave in Arlington, Pioneer Pkwy) takes a mailed DSC request within 30 days of your citation — judge approval required first; 90 days.

courts.name: Pelican Bay Municipal Court
courts.note: Pelican Bay (NW Tarrant near Azle) hasn't posted its DSC fee online — call the clerk at (817) 444-1234 by your appearance date for the amount and request steps.

courts.name: Richland Hills Municipal Court
courts.note: Richland Hills (NE Tarrant, Loop 820) charges a $10 admin fee plus court cost — mail or bring the request form by your appearance date (no fax or email).

courts.name: River Oaks Municipal Court
courts.note: River Oaks (SH-183) doesn't publish a DSC process online — contact the court directly and get approval before paying.

courts.name: Saginaw Municipal Court
courts.note: Saginaw requires DSC requests in person — no online or mail option. $144 fee at the window.

courts.name: Sansom Park Municipal Court
courts.note: Sansom Park (NW Fort Worth, SH-199) charges court costs plus a $10 admin fee — submit the request form in person or by mail by your appearance date; 90 days.

courts.name: Southlake Municipal Court
courts.note: Southlake requires a notarized affidavit with your request — court fee $144. The 90-day window starts when your plea is received.

courts.name: Watauga Municipal Court
courts.note: Watauga requires an in-person DSC request but accepts your completion documents by email.

courts.name: Westover Hills Municipal Court
courts.note: Westover Hills (Tarrant County enclave within Fort Worth) contracts its municipal court to Westworth Village — DSC dismissal costs $144 ($169 school zone); call (817) 710-2507 before your appearance date.

courts.name: Westworth Village Municipal Court
courts.note: Westworth Village (west Fort Worth, SH-183) charges $144 ($169 school zone) — request at the window, by email, or mail within 20 days of your citation.

courts.name: White Settlement Municipal Court
courts.note: White Settlement requires a notarized affidavit and gives no extensions on the 90-day window.
